leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Identify components that trigger unnecessary re-renders in an Angular application
Apply the OnPush change detection strategy to optimize component rendering
Construct immutable data patterns to prevent unintended re-renders
Configure input property tracking to control when components update
Implement pure pipes to transform data without causing re-renders
Manipulate component lifecycle hooks to optimize change detection
Bind event handlers efficiently to minimize template re-evaluations
